sections.heading: Six things that move the figure on an Accounting quote in Dubai
paragraphs: Weeks to the series is the largest single driver. A family booking in September for a November entry is buying availability at a quiet point in the year. A family booking in late March for May/June is competing with every other exam-year household in the emirate for the same small group of commerce specialists, and the rate moves accordingly. The subject makes this sharper than most: Accounting specialists are far thinner on the ground in Dubai than maths or physics teachers, so scarcity bites earlier.

Delivery format is the second. An in-home hour in Dubai is not the same product as an online hour, because the drive is inside the rate whether the invoice itemises it or not. Forty minutes each way across Al Khail Road at five o'clock is more than an hour of a teacher's working day, and nobody absorbs that for free. The third driver is who is actually teaching: subject-degree holders with current examination-board experience sit at the top of the band, and generalists who cover Accounting alongside four other subjects sit at the bottom.

Session length, frequency and commitment length make up the rest. Ninety-minute sessions often carry a slightly lower hourly figure than sixty-minute ones because setup time is amortised; pre-paid blocks are usually discounted against pay-as-you-go; two siblings in the same subject sometimes attract a shared rate, although that only works where both are genuinely at the same point in the specification. Ask which of these six is behind any quote you are given. A provider who can answer precisely is pricing a service; one who cannot is pricing a hunch.

sections.heading: What the 4AC1 specification actually contains, area by area
paragraphs: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Accounting is assessed entirely by written paper. There is no internally assessed component, no portfolio and no coursework, which removes a whole category of tutoring work that exists in other subjects and concentrates everything on exam performance. Confirm the current component structure, timings and mark totals on the specification document at qualifications.pearson.com rather than from any tutor's summary, including this one, because Pearson revises specification documents and a landing page is not an authoritative source for an assessment weighting.

The content itself divides cleanly. The first half builds the recording system: the accounting equation, double entry, day books, the cash book and petty cash, ledger accounts, and the trial balance. The second half tests whether the candidate can take that system to a year end: control accounts, bank reconciliation, correction of errors, depreciation, accruals and prepayments, irrecoverable debts, then the financial statements of sole traders, partnerships, limited companies and manufacturers, incomplete records, and ratio analysis with written interpretation.

Teaching time should not be distributed evenly across that list. The recording topics are learned once and then applied; the year-end adjustments and the interpretation questions are where the same candidate loses marks series after series. The table below maps each area to what the paper asks a candidate to produce, the failure that recurs most, and where an hour is best spent. It is written from marked-script patterns rather than from the specification's own ordering, which is why it reads differently from a revision guide contents page.

sections.heading: Depreciation, accruals and prepayments: the three adjustments that decide the grade
paragraphs: Ask a Year 11 Accounting candidate in Dubai to calculate reducing-balance depreciation and most will do it correctly. Ask the same candidate to post it, carry the accumulated figure forward, then dispose of the asset in year four, and the error rate climbs steeply. The calculation is arithmetic; the posting is a model. Candidates who memorised the first without building the second produce answers that are internally inconsistent, and a mark scheme that follows the figure through both statements catches that every time.

Accruals and prepayments fail for a related reason. Each adjustment has two consequences, one in the income statement and one in the statement of financial position, and they move in opposite directions. A candidate who learned accruals as a single rule about expenses will adjust the expense and leave the liability untouched, which costs marks twice over. The fix in a session is not more explanation. It is paired drilling: twenty small adjustments in a row, each one requiring both entries, until the second entry stops being an afterthought.

Irrecoverable debts and the allowance for them are the third of the set, and the one most often taught last and therefore least well. An increase in the allowance is a charge; a decrease is a credit; the net figure is what the income statement wants. Candidates who have met this only once, late in Year 11, reliably get the direction wrong under pressure. Treating these three adjustment families as one connected block rather than three separate topics is the single highest-return change to a 4AC1 revision plan.

sections.heading: Two Pearson series a year, and the money attached to each
paragraphs: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE qualifications are examined in a May/June series and a November series each year. That second window is the part most families do not plan for, and it changes the economics of tutoring considerably: a candidate who sits in November has a genuine route to improve in the following summer, and one who sits only in summer does not. The November 2026 final timetable runs from late October to 19 November 2026, which means the current series is live as this page is published.

Entry deadlines sit months ahead of the paper and are held by your child's school as the examination centre, not by you. The practical consequence is that a decision to add a subject, change tier where tiering applies, or enter a private candidate has to be made long before anyone feels ready. Pearson also publishes provisional timetables ahead of each series, including the International GCSE November 2027 series, so a family planning travel around a paper should work from the live official timetable rather than from a restated date on any tutoring site.

Results dates matter financially because they are the only point at which a retake decision can be made on evidence. June 2026 results reached centres on 19 August 2026 and students on 20 August 2026. November results arrive the following January: results from the November 2025 series reached students on 22 January 2026. Comparing component marks rather than the overall grade is what tells you whether a retake is worth paying for, and that comparison is free.

sections.heading: 4AC1 support inside a Dubai household budget
paragraphs: Tutoring is rarely the largest education line in a Dubai household, and it is almost always the most discretionary. School fees are fixed by contract, uniform and transport are fixed by the school, and the tutoring decision is the one place where a family actually chooses. KHDA's confirmation on 22 May 2026 that private school fees would not rise for 2026-27 removes one variable from that calculation for the current year, which is worth knowing before anyone decides a weekly hour is unaffordable.

The arithmetic that matters is annual rather than hourly. One qualified-tier online hour a week across a thirty-six week academic year is a meaningful commitment at market rates, and two hours a week through an exam term is roughly double it. Set against that, a diagnostic block of two or three sessions costs a fraction of either and sometimes resolves the problem outright, because a candidate who learns that their losses are all in interpretation questions can work on interpretation questions without paying anyone to watch.

Examination entry fees are separate and are not part of any tutor's rate. Where a school enters a candidate, the fee appears on the school invoice. Where a family enters a private candidate, the centre bills them directly and the amount varies by centre, so collect written quotes. sections.heading: Who may legally take your money for a private Accounting lesson in Dubai
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is permitted and regulated. Individuals giving private lessons need a private tuition work permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. The permit is granted free of charge for two years. MoHRE's own service listing, Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, shows no fee and a two-working-day completion time, applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website or e-services system. Anyone offering private tutoring without that permit is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws.

The eligible categories are wider than most parents expect: teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students. A permit is therefore not a quality signal. It is a legality signal, and the two are different things. A permitted tutor may still be a first-year undergraduate, and an outstanding teacher may not yet have applied. Ask for both: the permit position and the subject record.

Two further points are worth holding onto. A tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai is a different legal animal from an individual tutor and needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, so no provider should describe itself as approved by KHDA unless it holds one. And in Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit teachers from giving paid private tuition to pupils enrolled at their own school. Never arrange your child's own classroom teacher privately.

sections.heading: How the lesson actually runs, and what IB Gram does not sell in the UAE
paragraphs: Every session for a Dubai family happens online, one-to-one, over live video, with a shared whiteboard the teacher writes ledger accounts on while the candidate watches each posting appear. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE, and home visits are a service offered only in India. That is the same position stated on every country page on this site, and it is stated here so nobody books expecting a doorbell.

For Accounting specifically, the online format is not a compromise. The work is written: T-accounts, journals, statements and workings. A shared screen shows those being built line by line, with the candidate's own attempt visible alongside, which is closer to how a teacher marks than a kitchen table allows. Papers are scanned or photographed and annotated, and the annotated copy stays with the family. Nothing in the subject requires equipment, a laboratory or physical presence.

What the format actually changes is who can teach your child. A Dubai family restricted to tutors within a reasonable drive is choosing from whoever lives nearby and happens to know Accounting. The same family online is choosing from commerce specialists across time zones that overlap with Gulf Standard Time evenings. For a subject this thinly staffed, that is the difference between a specialist and a generalist, and it is the whole argument for the format. Where no specialist is free at the level needed, we say so rather than substituting someone who is not.

faqs.question: What does an Edexcel IGCSE Accounting 4AC1 tutor charge per hour in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Market rates in Dubai as at October 2026 put qualified one-to-one online subject teaching at roughly AED 150 to 300 an hour, with specialist support for international qualifications advertised at AED 200 to 450 and above. Budget online platforms advertise from the mid-forties, and a premium tier marketed on examiner background reaches AED 650. Visiting in-home tutors are advertised at roughly AED 180 to 500 with travel inside the rate. Those are market figures, not an IB Gram price list. Our own figure follows a free trial lesson, because it depends on the level, the weeks remaining and which teacher is actually free.

faqs.question: Why do 4AC1 quotes in Dubai range from AED 120 to over AED 480?
faqs.answer: Because an Accounting hour is not one product. At the low end you are buying supervision from someone who sat the subject recently and teaches from a textbook. At the high end you are buying diagnosis from a teacher who can read a candidate's trial balance and name the error type that produced the difference. Six things move the figure: weeks to the series, delivery format, who is teaching, session length, frequency, and whether you pre-pay a block. Ask any provider which of those is behind their number. A precise answer means a priced service; a vague one means a hunch.

faqs.question: Is a monthly 4AC1 package cheaper than paying by the hour in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the arithmetic is worth doing before you accept it. Monthly online packages advertised in this market sit around AED 799 for eight sessions, which works out near AED 100 an hour, below the qualified-teacher band. That tells you something about who is likely to be teaching. In-home monthly blocks around AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour visits price out differently again. Divide every package by the hours it contains, then compare that figure against the market band for the tier you actually want. A cheaper hourly rate for a less experienced teacher is not a saving if the hour returns fewer marks.

faqs.question: Does a quoted 4AC1 tutoring rate in the UAE include VAT?
faqs.answer: Ask, and get the answer in writing before you commit. Some providers quote inclusive, some exclusive, and the difference on a year of weekly sessions is material. IB Gram states whether VAT applies to a given arrangement at the point of quoting, after the trial lesson. What this page will not do is state how UAE VAT law treats tuition fees in general, because that is a Federal Tax Authority question, the answer depends on the provider's registration status and activity, and a tutoring website is not a source for tax advice. Treat any site that asserts a blanket answer with caution.

faqs.question: How many 4AC1 hours should a Dubai family budget for Year 11?
faqs.answer: It depends on where the candidate starts, and any provider giving a number before reading marked work is guessing. As a planning frame: one weekly hour across the academic year suits a candidate who understands the recording topics and is losing marks on year-end adjustments and interpretation. Two hours a week through the exam term suits one who has gaps in the recording system itself. A diagnostic block of two or three sessions costs a fraction of either and sometimes settles the question outright, because a candidate who learns their losses are all in interpretation can drill interpretation without paying anyone to supervise it.

faqs.question: Are 4AC1 lessons for Dubai families taught online or at a Dubai address?
faqs.answer: Online, one-to-one, over live video, timed to Gulf Standard Time. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE; home visiting is a service offered only in India. The search phrase includes tutor in Dubai because that is what parents type, and targeting it honestly means saying how the lesson is actually delivered rather than leaving you to find out. For Accounting the format costs you nothing: the work is written, a shared screen shows ledger accounts being built line by line, and the annotated papers stay with your family.

faqs.question: Which components make up the Pearson 4AC1 Accounting qualification?
faqs.answer: 4AC1 is Pearson Edexcel's International GCSE in Accounting and it is assessed entirely by written examination, with no internally assessed element and no coursework. Confirm the current component structure, timings and mark totals on the specification document at qualifications.pearson.com rather than from any tutoring site, including this one: Pearson revises specification documents and an assessment weighting needs an authoritative source. What is stable enough to plan around is the content split, between a recording half covering double entry through to the trial balance and a year-end half covering adjustments, financial statements and ratio analysis.

faqs.question: Does 4AC1 include any coursework a tutor might be asked to write?
faqs.answer: No, and that removes a risk other subjects carry. Accounting at this level is examined by written paper, so there is no portfolio, no internal assessment and nothing a tutor could be pressured into producing. Where a subject does carry assessed work, the line is the same and it is not negotiable: a tutor teaches, questions, marks and gives feedback on work the student has written. No tutor at IB Gram produces assessed work for a candidate. Examination boards treat that as malpractice, the consequence falls on the student, and any provider offering it should be avoided outright.

faqs.question: When are the Pearson 4AC1 exam series and when do entries close?
faqs.answer: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE qualifications are examined in a May/June series and a November series each year. The November 2026 final timetable runs from late October to 19 November 2026. Entry deadlines sit months before the papers and are held by your child's school as the examination centre, so adding a subject or entering a private candidate has to be decided well before anyone feels ready. Pearson publishes provisional timetables ahead of each series, including International GCSE November 2027, and any family planning travel should work from the live official timetable rather than a date restated on a tutoring page.

faqs.question: What changes if we start 4AC1 support six weeks before the paper?
faqs.answer: The work changes shape and the price moves with availability. Six weeks is too short to rebuild the recording system from scratch, but long enough to convert knowledge the candidate already has into marks: full papers under time, marked line by line, with priority set by marks lost per hour of revision. Expect the session to spend more time on interpretation questions and on format marks in the financial statements, because those are the fastest recoverable losses. Availability is the constraint rather than the teaching. Commerce specialists in this market are booked earliest in the weeks before a series, so the earlier call gets the better match.

faqs.question: Is a group Accounting class in Dubai worth the saving over one-to-one?
faqs.answer: It can be, for a specific candidate. Tuition centre group classes of two to four pupils are advertised at roughly AED 90 to 160 per pupil per hour in this market, a real saving against one-to-one. The trade is that a group follows a fixed scheme of work, so a candidate whose problem is a personal, recurring error pattern will sit through content they already have. Groups suit a pupil who needs structure and pace. One-to-one suits one who needs a specific fault diagnosed and drilled. Decide from marked work which of those describes your child, then price accordingly.

faqs.question: Does Accounting count towards the five subjects for UAE equivalency?
faqs.answer: On the British track, the Ministry of Education requires proof of five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates at a grade of no less than E or grade 3, plus one accredited subject at Advanced Level at no less than E or two at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade. Arabic and Islamic education are not included among the five required subjects. Accounting is an accredited IGCSE subject and would ordinarily sit inside that count, but verify your child's specific combination with the Ministry or the emirate attestation authority directly. IB Gram describes the process and does not perform or guarantee it, and no tutoring is required for it.

faqs.question: How do I check a Dubai tutor is permitted to charge for 4AC1 lessons?
faqs.answer: Ask directly whether they hold a private tuition work permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and granted free of charge for two years. MoHRE's service listing shows no fee and a two-working-day completion time, so there is no cost reason for a tutor not to hold one. Operating without it exposes the tutor to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. Note that the permit confirms legality rather than quality: eligible categories include university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Ask about the permit and the subject record separately.

faqs.question: What does the free first Accounting lesson actually include?
faqs.answer: A full one-to-one session with a teacher who has already read your child's most recent marked script, booked without card details, one per family. The candidate does Accounting in it rather than sitting a placement test, because how someone responds to teaching is more informative than how they score cold. Afterwards you get a short written note: what the teacher found, which error patterns recurred, and what the first six weeks would target. That note is yours whether you continue or not, and no quote is given until it has been sent.

faqs.question: Do Accounting tutoring rates in Dubai rise closer to the November series?
faqs.answer: Effective rates rise because availability falls, which is not quite the same thing as a price increase. In the weeks before a series the specialists are booked, so what remains at the original figure is the generalist tier, and families who wanted a subject specialist end up paying the specialist band or accepting someone less suited. Accounting is more exposed to this than maths or English because the pool of commerce teachers in this market is far smaller. Booking in the quiet part of the year buys a better match at a calmer figure, and gives the teaching enough weeks to work.

intro.heading: How a Dubai parent can tell whether biology tutoring is working
paragraphs: Three months into a tutoring arrangement, most parents in this market can report two things: the tutor is nice, and the child says it is helping. Neither is evidence. Both are compatible with a student who has enjoyed twelve pleasant hours and will sit the same paper they would have sat anyway. The gap is not usually dishonesty. It is that nobody recorded a starting point, so there is nothing for the present state to be compared against.

Biology makes this worse than the other sciences, for a specific reason. In chemistry a mole calculation is either right or wrong, and a parent can see the change in a fortnight. In physics a unit conversion either happens or it does not. Biology's marks sit largely in extended prose and in data interpretation, where an answer can look fluent and score three out of six, and where improvement is invisible to anyone who has not read the mark scheme. A student can write better biology for two months with no visible change in a report.

So the proposition on this page is narrow. Before any teaching happens, the student sits a baseline: a past paper section under timed conditions, marked against the real scheme, with every lost mark categorised. Those categories become the record. Coverage gaps, answer structure, data method, diagram labelling, terminology, and marks lost to not answering the question asked. The count in each category is written down, and it is the thing that either moves or does not over the following weeks.

What follows that is a sequence of artefacts rather than a sequence of reassurances. A marked long answer with the scheme's required points identified against what the student actually wrote. A redraft of the same answer. A short written note after each session naming the specification point worked on and the marks at stake. An unseen re-test a fortnight after a category is addressed. A re-scored baseline at the end of the term. A parent can read all of that in ten minutes a week without knowing any biology, and each of those documents is capable of disappointing, which is precisely what makes them worth having rather than decorative.

On delivery, plainly: parents search for a home tutor because the child is at home in Dubai and the need feels local, and the phrase deserves an honest answer. IB Gram does not arrange home visits in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE; home visits are a service offered only in India. Biology lessons run one to one over live video on Gulf Standard Time. For an evidence-led arrangement that is not a concession but an advantage: screen work is captured by default, so the marked answer, the redraft and the written note all exist as documents a parent can actually read.

dubai/edexcel-igcse-biology-4bi1-home-tu.programmesIntro: Evidence looks different at each stage of a British-curriculum route in Dubai, because the assessments a school produces change. These four stages are where a parent can actually get a reading on biology.

programmes.name: Where the evidence trail should start
programmes.description: The first year in which a student writes 4BI1-style extended answers and the best year to establish a baseline, because there is time for the record to show movement. A Year 10 baseline also separates two things that look identical later: a student who has not yet been taught a section, and one who was taught it and did not retain it. By Year 11 that distinction has blurred.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai schools differ in how much they annotate Year 10 work. Some return per-question marks and a breakdown; others return a grade and a comment. Ask the biology teacher which you will receive, because it determines whether a family needs an external baseline at all. Where the school already provides per-question data, use it rather than duplicating it.

programmes.name: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology
programmes.description: Paper 1B of two hours for 110 marks and Paper 2B of one hour fifteen minutes for 70 marks, 180 marks in total, untiered, reported 9 to 1, with no coursework and no separate practical examination. Because there is no coursework, every piece of evidence about a 4BI1 student is written examination-style work, which makes the record cleaner than in qualifications with an internal component.
programmes.countryNote: Confirm the code on the exam entry statement rather than assuming. Dubai schools often enter Pearson for one science and Cambridge for another, and the two biology specifications differ in structure and in practical arrangements. Tracking a student against the wrong scheme produces a record that looks rigorous and measures the wrong thing.

programmes.name: The school assessment calendar as evidence
programmes.description: School mocks are the most useful external check on a tutoring arrangement, because nobody involved in the tutoring sets or marks them. A tutoring record that predicts a mock result reasonably well is a record worth trusting. One that shows steady improvement while mocks stay flat is measuring the wrong thing, and that discrepancy is itself the most valuable piece of information a parent gets.
programmes.countryNote: Ask the school for its assessment calendar at the start of the year and plan tutoring blocks to finish two weeks before each mock, not during it. Dubai schools commonly run mocks in November and February for Year 11, which means a block started in September has a genuine external checkpoint before the winter break.

programmes.name: What the record is for after 16
programmes.description: A 4BI1 grade is a gate for students heading into International A Level Biology, IB Diploma Biology, or medicine, dentistry and biomedical applications. A documented record of what a student found difficult at sixteen is also useful at seventeen, because the same pattern usually recurs under a heavier load: students who lost extended-answer marks in 4BI1 lose them again in A Level essays unless the habit was addressed.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai had 387,441 private-school students across 227 schools in 2024-25, with 37% on a UK curriculum and 7% in the International Baccalaureate, so the post-16 choice is live for most 4BI1 candidates. No tutoring provider should suggest that tutoring is required for university admission or for Ministry of Education equivalency, because neither is true.

dubai/edexcel-igcse-biology-4bi1-home-tu.subjectsIntro: The ten items below are the artefacts a 4BI1 student produces that can actually be assessed. Each one is a piece of written work with a scheme behind it, which is why each can be tracked rather than merely discussed.

subjects.name: Osmosis investigation write-up
subjects.description: The potato or visking tubing experiment, written up with variables, method, results and conclusion. Shows whether the student can name a concentration gradient and a partially permeable membrane, and whether percentage change was calculated rather than raw mass compared. A single write-up diagnoses three separate skills.

subjects.name: Enzyme rate graph question
subjects.description: Temperature or pH against rate of reaction. Reveals whether the student reads an optimum off a curve, explains denaturation in terms of the active site, and distinguishes a plateau from a maximum. Graph questions are the fastest reliable indicator of data method in this subject.

subjects.name: Six-mark gas exchange or digestion answer
subjects.description: The heaviest category of lost marks on most 4BI1 scripts. A marked copy shows how many of the scheme's required points appeared in a fluent answer, which is usually fewer than the student expected. The single most informative artefact a parent can ask to see.

subjects.name: Negative feedback explanation
subjects.description: Temperature regulation or blood glucose control. Distinguishes a student who describes what happens from one who explains why, which is the difference between half marks and full marks on this question type. Marked copies make the distinction obvious even to a non-biologist.

subjects.name: Genetic diagram with ratio stated
subjects.description: Monohybrid crosses with parental genotypes, gametes, offspring genotypes and the phenotype ratio. There is a required layout and marks are routinely lost on the gamete row or on omitting the ratio the question asked for. A clean, binary piece of evidence: either the layout is right or it is not.

subjects.name: Food web, pyramid and energy transfer question
subjects.description: Reading a web, constructing a pyramid of number or biomass, and explaining energy loss between trophic levels. Shows whether the student applies a principle to unfamiliar organisms or recites a learnt chain, which is exactly what Pearson suggest-stems test.

subjects.name: Carbon or nitrogen cycle diagram
subjects.description: Marks depend on naming the process at each arrow rather than describing the cycle in general. A completed diagram is quick to check and tells a parent whether the student has learnt the cycle as a picture or as a sequence of named processes, which is the distinction the scheme cares about.

subjects.name: Transpiration or photosynthesis data table
subjects.description: Rate calculations, percentage change and unit handling from a table of readings. Shows whether the student states a unit, chooses the right pair of readings, and spots an anomaly. Two or three of these establish data method more reliably than any amount of discussion.

subjects.name: Selective breeding and genetic modification comparison
subjects.description: Taught last in most Dubai schemes of work and revised least, so a blank answer here is usually coverage rather than ability. Useful early as a coverage check: if Section 5 is empty in October of Year 11, the plan needs a coverage block, not answer-structure work.

subjects.name: Diagram labelling test, cold
subjects.levels: Across all five sections · recall evidence
subjects.description: Heart, kidney nephron, leaf cross-section, flower, digestive system, neurone. Scored out of a fixed total and repeatable, which makes it the cheapest piece of trackable evidence in the subject. A ten-minute cold test every fortnight produces a line on a graph that a parent can read at a glance.

sections.heading: The evidence a parent is entitled to ask for
paragraphs: Most tutoring in this market produces no durable record, and nobody is hiding anything: the hour is spent teaching, a verbal summary happens at the end, and the family's only artefact is a memory. That is fine when the subject improves visibly and useless when it does not. The remedy is to agree, before the first paid hour, which documents the arrangement will produce and how often, and then to read them.

The list is short and none of it requires a parent to understand biology. A baseline score with lost marks counted by category. A marked long answer showing the scheme's required points beside what the student wrote. A one-page note after each session naming the specification point and the marks at stake. An unseen re-test score, dated at least a fortnight after the work it tests. A re-scored baseline at the end of the term. Five artefacts, each of which can be checked in minutes.

What makes these useful rather than decorative is that each can disappoint. A re-test score that has not moved is information. A note that says the same thing three weeks running is information. A category count that is flat while the tutor reports progress is the single most valuable thing a parent can discover, and it is discoverable only if the count exists. A provider who objects to producing these is telling you something; a provider who produces them without being asked is unusual in this market.

sections.heading: Twelve weeks of 4BI1 work, and what each week should leave behind
paragraphs: A term of biology tutoring can be described in advance, which is itself a useful test of a provider. The sequence below is what a tracked weekly hour produces across twelve weeks, with the artefact each week generates in the right-hand column. It is not a syllabus plan, because the content depends on the baseline; it is a plan for the record, and the record is what tells a family whether the content plan was right.

Two features of the sequence are deliberate and worth explaining. Re-tests are set a fortnight after the work they test, never at the end of the same session, because a test sat immediately measures short-term memory and produces a flattering number. And the baseline is re-scored at week twelve using a comparable paper section rather than the same one, so the comparison is of ability rather than of familiarity.

The sequence also has a built-in decision point at week six. If the largest category has not moved by then, the diagnosis was probably wrong, and the honest response is to re-diagnose rather than to continue with more of the same. Families rarely get that conversation offered, because continuing is easier to sell than admitting a wrong call. A record that makes a wrong call visible at week six is worth considerably more than one that makes it visible in June. The twelve weeks also end with a coverage check rather than more teaching, because by that point the most useful question is often which parts of the specification the school has not yet reached, and that list belongs to the family's planning rather than to any single session.

sections.heading: Reading a Pearson biology mark scheme without being a biologist
paragraphs: A published mark scheme is the most useful document in this process and the one families never open. It is written in a compressed notation that looks forbidding and is actually simple, and once a parent can read it they can check a marked answer themselves rather than relying on an interpretation. It also explains why a fluent six-mark answer scored three, which is the question most families are really asking.

The conventions to know are few. A scheme may offer more acceptable points than there are marks, capped by a maximum, so an answer containing four valid points on a three-mark question earns three. Alternative wordings are usually indicated as acceptable, and an instruction to ignore a particular statement means it neither gains nor loses credit. The reverse form of an argument is commonly allowed where the biology is equivalent. An error carried forward convention means a wrong value used correctly afterwards can still earn the later marks.

Reference the official document rather than relying on any provider's copy. Pearson owns its mark schemes and past papers, and a tutor should name the series and the paper and point you to the official source rather than distributing scans. Where a school has already issued a paper to its own cohort, working from that is ordinary teaching. The table gives the conventions in plain language; check the notation page of the actual scheme for your child's series, because the published document always states its own conventions.

sections.heading: The baseline paper, and why it is sat rather than discussed
paragraphs: The first session in an evidence-led arrangement contains no teaching. The student sits a past-paper section under timed conditions, with the clock visible, and then it is marked properly against the scheme. Families sometimes resist this, reasonably: it feels like paying for an hour in which nothing was taught. What it buys is the only fixed point in the whole arrangement, and without it every later claim about progress is unfalsifiable.

Sitting it matters more than discussing it. A conversation about what a student finds difficult produces the topics they are aware of finding difficult, which is a different and much shorter list. Students are consistently wrong about this in biology: they report struggling with genetics, where the layout is learnable in two sessions, and report being fine with gas exchange, where a fluent answer is quietly scoring half marks. Only a marked script separates perceived difficulty from actual lost marks.

The categories used are the same every time, which is what makes the record comparable. Coverage, meaning the section has not been taught or retained. Structure, meaning extended answers do not contain separable points. Data method, meaning rates, percentages, units and anomalies. Diagram and terminology recall. Question reading, meaning the student answered a different question from the one printed. Each gets a count out of the marks available, and those six numbers are the baseline that week twelve is compared against. Keeping the categories fixed is what makes the exercise worth repeating: a new set of labels every term would produce six fresh numbers and no comparison at all, which is how most tutoring records quietly become unusable by the spring.

sections.heading: What counts as progress in biology, and what only looks like it
paragraphs: Several things feel like progress in this subject and are not. Finishing a topic is not progress; it is coverage, and a student can cover all five sections and score the same because their answers still do not contain separable points. Doing more past papers is not progress unless the papers are marked properly and the pattern across them is read. Feeling more confident is not progress, and it is the signal families rely on most, because it is the only one available without a record.

The things that are progress are narrow and checkable. A six-mark answer that scores five where comparable answers scored three. A cold diagram test score that rises and stays risen a month later. A data question answered with a unit and a correct pair of readings, twice in a row, two weeks apart. A coverage list with fewer gaps on it than last month. A mock result that moves in the same direction as the tutoring record, which is the external confirmation nobody in the arrangement controls.

The most useful discipline is to require a gap. Anything tested in the session it was taught in tells you nothing, and most reported tutoring progress is of exactly that kind. A fortnight is the minimum useful interval, a month is better, and a repair that survives both is real. That single rule removes most of the overstatement from tutoring reports, and it is the one a parent can enforce without knowing any biology at all.

sections.heading: Grade movement, boundaries and why no number can be promised
paragraphs: Parents reasonably want the record expressed as a grade, and that is where honesty has to intervene. A raw mark out of 180 becomes a grade through boundaries set after the series has been sat and marked, and those boundaries move between series. A tutoring record can therefore report marks reliably and grades only loosely. Anyone converting a practice score into a confident grade prediction is adding precision that does not exist.

What the record can say is directional and still useful. Lost marks in the structure category fell from eighteen to six across a term. Cold diagram scores rose and held. The coverage gap list went from three sections to one. A parent reading that knows what changed and roughly what it is worth, without being told a number that the examination will decide. No tutor can promise a particular grade, and a provider offering one should be asked to publish the refund terms on the same page.

Do not accept published grade-boundary tables from a tutoring provider either. Boundaries belong to the examination board, they are released through official channels, and reproducing them is both a copyright matter and a route to quoting a figure from the wrong series. Reference the official source, use the practice marks for direction, and keep the conversation about marks and categories rather than about a predicted grade that nobody is in a position to issue. The school is the right place for a predicted grade, because it holds the full assessment history and issues the prediction formally. A tutoring record is an input to that judgement and not a substitute for it, and a provider who presents it as one has misunderstood what the document is for.

sections.heading: Home tutor or online: which arrangement leaves a record
paragraphs: This is where the delivery question becomes a practical one rather than a preference. IB Gram does not arrange home visits in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE; biology lessons run one to one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, and home visits are a service offered only in India. The in-home market in the emirate is real, published at AED 180 to 350 an hour in Bestimate's 2026 Dubai table and advertised to AED 500 by individual home tutors, with travel inside the figure.

On evidence specifically, the two formats are not equivalent. Screen work is captured by default: the marked answer, the list of scheme points, the redraft and the written note all exist as files when the hour ends. In a living room, the same work happens in the student's exercise book and in conversation, and what reaches a parent is a summary delivered at the door. Neither tutor is being evasive; one format produces documents and the other does not.

There is one genuine advantage on the other side and it should be stated. A person in the room is harder to ignore than a person on a screen, and for a younger student or one who will not begin work unsupervised, that matters more than any record. A family in that position is better served by an in-home arrangement with a deliberately imposed record: a marked answer photographed each week, a written note required, and a cold test score logged. The structure is what matters; the format just makes it easier or harder.

sections.heading: Evidence about the tutor, not just about the student
paragraphs: The same standard applies in the other direction. A family is entitled to evidence about the person teaching, and in this market most of what is offered instead is an adjective. The checks below cost nothing and take about fifteen minutes in total, and they separate a 4BI1 specialist from a general science tutor more reliably than any credential list.

The most informative is the ten-minute test. Send one six-mark biology answer your child has already written and ask the tutor to identify which of the scheme's required points are present and which are missing. Someone who teaches this specification will do it quickly and specifically. Someone who does not will comment on the writing. No qualification claim predicts the answer to that question as well as the answer itself does.

On regulatory status, the position should be stated rather than implied. Private tutoring in the UAE requires the MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, granted free of charge for two years, covering registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and students aged 15 to 18. Tutoring without one attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no fine schedule is published, so ignore quoted amounts. IB Gram holds no approval, licence or endorsement from KHDA, ADEK, SPEA, the Ministry of Education, MoHRE, Pearson or Cambridge, and claims none. One further check is worth making in Abu Dhabi and worth understanding in Dubai: ADEK's professional-ethics rules bar private and charter school staff from paid tutoring of students enrolled at their own school, and the permit carries its own code of conduct, so an offer of your child's own class teacher privately is a reason to ask more questions rather than fewer.

sections.heading: Evidence that the work is the student's own
paragraphs: An evidence trail cuts both ways, and the last thing it has to establish is authorship. 4BI1 has no coursework and no internal assessment, which removes the commonest route to trouble in international qualifications, and the principle still has to hold for everything else: a tutor teaches, questions, marks and gives feedback on work the student has written. Redrafting an answer with a student is teaching. Writing the answer for them is not, and the record should make the difference visible.

In practice that means the student's own version is kept alongside the redraft rather than replaced by it. A marked answer with the original visible, the scheme's points listed, and a second attempt written by the student is a document that demonstrates learning. A single polished answer in the tutor's phrasing demonstrates nothing and teaches the student that a good answer is something that arrives from outside. The first costs a few extra minutes and is worth considerably more in April.

This market contains providers who go further than ghostwriting a sentence. One operator sells completed Internal Assessments for other qualifications at AED 3,750, which is an academic-integrity breach that the student carries and the seller does not. Any arrangement a family enters should be describable to the school without embarrassment, and the record is the test of that: if the artefacts are the student's own work with feedback on it, the arrangement is sound. The same reasoning applies to anything a student submits internally in Dubai, from a practical write-up to a mock sat in school conditions: the usable evidence is a document the student produced, annotated by somebody who knows what the scheme rewards, and kept so that the next version can be compared against it.

process.title: Agree the artefacts before the first paid hour
process.description: Name the five documents the arrangement will produce and how often: baseline with category counts, marked long answers, a one-page note after each session, dated re-test scores, and a term-end re-score. A provider who agrees to that in writing has changed the nature of the arrangement before it starts.

process.title: Sit the baseline, do not discuss it
process.description: Session one is a timed past-paper section with no teaching in it, marked properly afterwards. It feels like a wasted hour and it is the only fixed point the arrangement will have. Student self-report is collected but not used as the diagnosis, because students are reliably wrong about which biology questions are costing them marks.

process.title: Work the largest category and require a gap
process.description: Three to five sessions on the biggest count, then unseen questions of the same type a fortnight later. Nothing is re-tested in the session it was taught in. That single rule removes most of the overstatement from tutoring reports and is enforceable by a parent with no knowledge of biology.

process.title: Use week six as a decision point
process.description: If the largest category has not moved by then, the diagnosis was probably wrong and the honest step is to re-diagnose rather than continue. Continuing is easier to sell, which is why this conversation is rarely offered. A record that exposes a wrong call at week six is worth more than one that exposes it in June.

process.title: Check the record against the school's mock
process.description: The mock is the external test nobody in the arrangement sets or marks. A tutoring record that roughly predicts it is trustworthy. A record showing steady gains alongside a flat mock is measuring the wrong thing, and that discrepancy is the most valuable single piece of information a family will get all year.

process.title: Hand over cleanly if the tutor changes
process.description: Another 4BI1 specialist should pick up the same baseline, the same category counts and the same priority order, with nothing re-assessed and nothing re-charged. Confirm it in writing beforehand, because a provider who restarts the diagnosis is charging twice for one piece of work and losing the comparison in the process.

whyPoints.title: A fixed starting point, written down
whyPoints.description: A timed, marked baseline with lost marks counted in six fixed categories is the only thing that makes a later claim about progress checkable. Without it, three months of pleasant sessions and three months of effective sessions are indistinguishable, which is the normal state of tutoring in this market.

whyPoints.title: Re-tests with a gap enforced
whyPoints.description: Nothing is tested in the session it was taught in. A fortnight is the minimum and a month is better, because a repair that survives the gap is real and one that does not is short-term memory. This is the single most effective check a parent can impose without understanding the subject.

whyPoints.title: Marks and categories, never a predicted grade
whyPoints.description: Raw marks are reportable; grades depend on boundaries set after a series is marked and moving between series. The record says what the counts did. Nobody involved is in a position to issue a grade, and no tutor can promise one, so the conversation stays on the quantities that actually exist.

whyPoints.title: The school's mock treated as the referee
whyPoints.description: An external assessment nobody in the arrangement controls is the best available check on whether the tutoring record is measuring anything. Blocks are planned to finish two weeks before each mock so the comparison is clean, and a flat mock against a positive record triggers a re-diagnosis rather than an explanation.

whyPoints.title: Evidence demanded about the tutor too
whyPoints.description: Ask any prospective tutor to mark one six-mark answer and name the scheme points that are missing. That fifteen-minute test separates a 4BI1 specialist from a general science tutor more reliably than a credential list, and it works at every price point in this market.

whyPoints.title: Delivered online, with the record as a by-product
whyPoints.description: Lessons run one to one over live video. IB Gram does not arrange home visits in the UAE. Where an in-home tutor would suit a student better, this page says so and says what to insist on instead: a photographed marked answer weekly, a written note, and a logged cold test score.

faqs.question: What evidence shows whether 4BI1 tutoring in Dubai is changing anything?
faqs.answer: Compare a dated, unseen re-test score against a recorded starting point. Without a baseline there is nothing to compare, which is why three months of pleasant sessions and three months of effective sessions look identical to a parent. The checkable signals are narrow: the same answer type scoring higher two weeks later, a cold recall score that is still higher a month afterwards, and fewer sections on the coverage gap list. Confidence, topics covered and papers attempted are not evidence, though they are what most families are given.

faqs.question: What should a baseline session for 4BI1 involve?
faqs.answer: A timed past-paper section sat under conditions, with no teaching in the hour, then marked properly against the scheme afterwards. Every lost mark is sorted into the same six categories each time: coverage, answer structure, data method, diagram and terminology recall, question reading, and arithmetic. Those six counts are the fixed point everything later is compared against. It feels like paying for an hour in which nothing was taught, and it is the only part of the arrangement that makes the rest falsifiable.

faqs.question: Why does my child's fluent six-mark biology answer only score three?
faqs.answer: Because extended answers are credited on the points the scheme requires, not on how the writing reads. A student can produce a well-constructed paragraph containing three of the four required ideas and earn three marks while feeling they wrote a strong answer. Seeing the scheme's list beside their own sentences is usually the moment the problem becomes obvious to the student. The repair is redrafting against the scheme, one answer at a time, until the student writes in separable points rather than in prose.

faqs.question: Can I read a Pearson mark scheme myself without knowing biology?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the most useful document in this process. The notation is compressed rather than complicated: a scheme often lists more acceptable points than there are marks, capped by a maximum; alternative wordings are shown as acceptable; some statements are to be ignored rather than penalised; the reverse form of an argument is frequently allowed; and an error carried forward convention lets later marks survive an earlier wrong value. Check the notation page of the actual scheme for your child's series, since the published document states its own conventions.

faqs.question: Why should a re-test wait two weeks instead of happening at the end of the session?
faqs.answer: Because a test sat immediately measures what the student remembers from the last hour, which is always flattering and tells a parent nothing. Most reported tutoring progress is of exactly that kind. A fortnight is the minimum useful interval and a month is better, and a repair that survives both is a habit rather than a recollection. It is also the one quality check a parent can enforce without any subject knowledge: ask for the date on every re-test score.

faqs.question: What should I receive after each biology session?
faqs.answer: One page, in the same format every week: the specification point worked on, the marks at stake, what the student produced, and what they are expected to do before the next session. Longer notes do not get read, and shorter ones carry nothing. A note that says the same thing three weeks running is itself information, usually that the category being worked on was the wrong one. Agree the format before the first paid hour rather than hoping for it afterwards.

faqs.question: My child's school only sends a grade and a comment. Is that enough to work from?
faqs.answer: Not on its own, and it is the common position in larger Dubai cohorts where annotating thirty sets of long answers is impractical. A grade with a comment cannot tell you whether marks went on coverage, on answer structure or on data method, and those need completely different work. Where a school does publish per-question marks, use that data rather than generating a second set. Where it does not, an external baseline is the cheapest way to get a breakdown that can be tracked.

faqs.question: Can a tutor tell me what grade my child will get in 4BI1?
faqs.answer: No, and a provider who offers a number is adding precision that does not exist. A raw mark out of 180 becomes a grade through boundaries set after the series has been sat and marked, and those boundaries move between series. What a record can honestly report is direction and quantity: lost marks in the structure category fell from eighteen to six, cold recall scores rose and held, the coverage gap list shortened. No tutor can promise a particular grade.

faqs.question: Should tutoring blocks be planned around the school mocks?
faqs.answer: Yes, and finishing two weeks before each mock rather than running through it makes the comparison clean. The mock is the one assessment nobody in the tutoring arrangement sets or marks, which makes it the referee. A tutoring record that roughly predicts the mock result is trustworthy. A record showing steady gains alongside a flat mock means the tutoring is measuring something other than what the examination measures, and that should trigger a re-diagnosis.

faqs.question: Which biology artefact tells you the most about a student in one look?
faqs.answer: A marked six-mark answer on gas exchange or digestion, with the scheme's required points listed beside what the student wrote. It shows coverage, answer structure and question reading at once, and it is the category where most 4BI1 marks are lost. A cold diagram labelling test is the cheapest repeatable measure, scoring out of a fixed total every fortnight, which produces a line a parent can read at a glance. Those two cover most of what matters.

faqs.question: Does an online biology tutor leave more of a record than a visiting one?
faqs.answer: In practice yes, because screen work is captured by default. The marked answer, the list of scheme points, the redraft and the written note all exist as files when the hour ends, and a parent who was not in the room can read them. In a living room the same work happens in the student's exercise book and in conversation. Neither tutor is being evasive; one format produces documents and the other does not. If you use an in-home tutor, impose the record deliberately.

faqs.question: Is an in-home tutor ever the better choice for biology?
faqs.answer: For a younger student or one who will not begin work unsupervised, genuinely yes, because a person in the room is harder to ignore than a person on a screen. IB Gram does not offer it: lessons run one to one over live video and home visits are a service offered only in India. Published in-home rates in Dubai run AED 180 to 350 an hour, with home tutors advertising to AED 500, since travel sits inside the figure. If you go that route, require a photographed marked answer and a written note weekly.

faqs.question: How can I check a biology tutor knows Edexcel 4BI1 specifically?
faqs.answer: Send one six-mark answer your child has already written and ask which of the scheme's required points are present and which are missing. A tutor who teaches this specification answers quickly and specifically; one who does not comments on the writing. Ask also which content 4BI1 examines only in Paper 2B. Those two questions take fifteen minutes and separate a specialist from a general science tutor more reliably than any list of qualifications, at every price point in this market.

faqs.question: What stops a tutor from simply writing the answers for my child?
faqs.answer: The record, if it is kept properly. The student's own version is retained alongside the redraft rather than replaced by it, so a marked answer shows the original, the scheme's points and a second attempt in the student's own words. A single polished answer in the tutor's phrasing demonstrates nothing. 4BI1 has no coursework, which removes the commonest version of this risk, and a tutor should teach, question, mark and give feedback on work the student wrote.

faqs.question: Can a tutor give us past papers, mark schemes and grade boundary tables?
faqs.answer: A tutor should name the series and the paper and point you to the official source rather than distributing copies, because Pearson owns that material. Working through a paper the school has already issued to its cohort is ordinary teaching. Grade boundary tables in particular should never come from a tutoring provider: they belong to the board, they are released through official channels, and a table from the wrong series produces a confident prediction built on the wrong numbers.

faqs.question: What happens to the record if we change tutor halfway through?
faqs.answer: It should transfer intact. Another 4BI1 specialist picks up the same baseline, the same six category counts and the same priority order, with nothing re-assessed and nothing re-charged. Confirm that in writing before the first paid hour, because a provider who restarts the diagnosis charges twice for one piece of work and destroys the comparison in the process. Two or three sessions is enough to know whether a match is right, and saying so early costs a week rather than a term.

intro.heading: Biology is postponed, and postponement is what it costs
paragraphs: Of the three separate sciences, biology is the one Dubai families leave until last. The reason is intuitive and mostly wrong: biology looks like reading. There are fewer equations than in physics, no mole arithmetic as in chemistry, and a great deal of content that appears learnable from a revision guide the week before. So physics and chemistry get the weekly hour from Year 10 and biology gets a block in April, and the block is where the money goes.

The arithmetic is worth laying out. One hour a week across the two years of a 4BI1 course, at the published Dubai band of AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor, is a steady monthly line that Bestimate's 2026 estimates put at AED 600 to 1,200 for mid-range weekly tutoring. A twelve-week rescue at two sessions a week in the term before the series is twenty-four hours bought at specialist rates of AED 200 to 450 and above, at the time of year when diaries are fullest and timing is least negotiable. The second option buys fewer total hours, costs more per hour, and arrives too late to change the student's working habits.

What makes biology expensive late rather than merely difficult late is its breadth. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology is organised into five sections: the nature and variety of living organisms, structure and functions in living organisms, reproduction and inheritance, ecology and the environment, and use of biological resources. That is a wide recall surface, and a wide recall surface cannot be compressed. A student can learn the mole in six hours because it is one idea. Nobody learns five sections of biology in six hours, at any price.

The second cost driver is invisible on most rate cards. Biology carries the heaviest extended-prose load of the three sciences, and extended prose has to be marked by a person. A tutor who properly marks a 4BI1 long-answer section spends real time on it outside the lesson, and that time is either inside the quoted rate, billed separately, or not happening. Of the published rates in this market, none states which. It is the single most useful question a Dubai parent can ask before paying for biology tutoring specifically.

The bands themselves, as published in October 2026: budget online from AED 33 to 65 an hour and broadly AED 45 to 150; qualified subject tutors online at AED 150 to 300, with Unitors listing International GCSE from AED 150; specialists at AED 200 to 450 and above, with TutorChase about AED 270; in-home one-to-one at AED 180 to 350 in Bestimate's Dubai table, with home tutors advertising to AED 500; premium named tutors at AED 500 to 650 and above, with BartyED at AED 650. IB Gram quotes after a free thirty-minute consultation and no card details are taken. Lessons are delivered one to one over live video; IB Gram does not arrange home visits in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE, because home visits are offered only in India.

dubai/edexcel-igcse-biology-4bi1-tutor.programmesIntro: Four plans account for almost every 4BI1 purchase a Dubai family makes, and they differ by an order of magnitude in total cost. Choosing between them in Year 10 rather than in Year 11 is the whole of the saving available in this subject.

programmes.name: One weekly hour across the full course
programmes.description: The cheapest plan per mark and the one families choose least for biology. A single hour a week that moves with the school's teaching order consolidates each section as it is taught, which means the recall surface is built gradually instead of assembled under pressure. It also catches the extended-prose habit early, when a student still has time to change how they write an answer.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai schools vary in how they sequence biology across Years 10 and 11, and some begin 4BI1 content in Year 9 on a three-year Key Stage 4. Ask the head of science for the scheme of work. A plan built on the school's actual order is worth considerably more than one built on the specification order, because the student is assessed on what the school has taught.

programmes.name: Twelve-week block before the series
programmes.description: Two sessions a week aimed at whichever sections the marked mock shows weakest, with recall-heavy material taken first because it returns the most marks per hour. It works, and it is the most expensive way to arrive at the same place. Twenty-four hours at specialist rates in the term when demand peaks, with no time left to change how the student writes.
programmes.countryNote: Diaries in Dubai tighten sharply in the eight weeks before a Pearson series, so a rescue block booked in March for a summer series will usually be offered the slots nobody else wanted. Families who know in January that biology is the weak subject should book then, at the same rate, with the choice of hours still open.

programmes.name: Summer or winter break catch-up
programmes.description: Dubai's long summer break is the most under-used tutoring window in the emirate and the cheapest time to cover biology breadth. No school homework competes, concentration is better in the morning, and sessions can run three times a week without displacing anything. A section covered properly in July does not need rescuing in April.
programmes.countryNote: Many Dubai families travel for part of the summer, which makes video delivery useful rather than merely acceptable: sessions can follow the family if the time difference allows, and pause cleanly if it does not. Agree in advance what happens to unused sessions in a package, because that clause causes more disputes in this market than the rate does.

programmes.name: Biology after 16, and the prerequisite question
programmes.description: International A Level Biology and IB Diploma Biology both expand the data-handling and extended-writing demands that 4BI1 introduces, and the Diploma adds an internal assessment. Students aiming at medicine, dentistry, veterinary or biomedical routes need biology at the next level, which makes the 4BI1 grade a gate rather than an endpoint and changes how early a family should intervene.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai had 387,441 private-school students across 227 schools in 2024-25, with 37% on a UK curriculum and 7% in the International Baccalaureate, so the post-16 choice is live for most 4BI1 students in the emirate. Do not accept any claim that tutoring is required for university admission or for Ministry of Education equivalency; neither is true, and both are used as pressure.

dubai/edexcel-igcse-biology-4bi1-tutor.subjectsIntro: The ten areas below are where 4BI1 marks sit, each flagged as recall-led or reasoning-led, because that distinction decides both the format and the cost of the help a student needs.

subjects.name: Characteristics and variety of living organisms
subjects.description: The five kingdoms, the features of plants, animals, fungi, protoctists, bacteria and viruses, and the characteristics common to living organisms. Pure recall with a predictable question style, which makes it cheap to repair and the obvious candidate for group or pair tuition rather than one to one.

subjects.name: Cells, enzymes and transport across membranes
subjects.description: Cell structure, enzyme action and the effects of temperature and pH, diffusion, osmosis and active transport. Osmosis questions are the classic loss: students describe water moving without naming the concentration gradient or the partially permeable membrane, and the scheme wants both.

subjects.name: Nutrition and transport in plants
subjects.description: Photosynthesis, limiting factors, leaf structure, mineral requirements, transpiration and the transport tissues. Graph-based limiting-factor questions reward method over recall, and students who have practised reading a plateau off a graph score where students who have memorised the equation do not.

subjects.name: Human nutrition, circulation and respiration
subjects.description: The digestive system, enzymes and absorption, the heart and blood vessels, gas exchange and aerobic and anaerobic respiration. The heaviest extended-prose block on the specification, where four and six-mark answers are won or lost on structure rather than on content.

subjects.name: Coordination, homeostasis and excretion
subjects.description: The nervous system, reflex arcs, hormones, temperature regulation, osmoregulation and kidney function. Negative feedback explanations are frequently answered as descriptions, losing the causal marks. Kidney questions reward a clear sequence over a long paragraph.

subjects.name: Reproduction in plants and humans
subjects.description: Flower structure, pollination, fertilisation, seed and fruit formation, the human reproductive system, gametes, the menstrual cycle and development. Largely recall with diagram labelling, so it is well suited to shared sessions and to independent revision with testing rather than teaching.

subjects.name: Inheritance, variation and selection
subjects.description: Chromosomes, DNA, mitosis and meiosis, monohybrid inheritance, genetic diagrams, sex determination, mutation, variation, natural selection and evolution. Genetic diagram questions have a required layout, and marks go missing on gamete rows and on failing to state the ratio asked for.

subjects.name: Ecology and the environment
subjects.description: Food chains and webs, pyramids of number and biomass, energy transfer, the carbon and nitrogen cycles, population growth, pollution, eutrophication and the greenhouse effect. Cycle questions reward a stated process at each arrow rather than a general account of the cycle.

subjects.name: Use of biological resources
subjects.description: Crop plants and glasshouse conditions, micro-organisms in food production, fish farming, selective breeding, genetic modification and cloning. Taught last in most Dubai schemes of work and revised least, which makes it the single most profitable section to cover during a holiday block.

subjects.name: Data, graphs and practical skills in written questions
subjects.description: Reading tables and graphs, calculating rates and percentage change, identifying variables, describing a method, spotting anomalies and evaluating a conclusion. There is no separate practical paper in 4BI1, so these marks are the least practised and the most reliably available.

sections.heading: What postponing biology actually costs, counted in hours
paragraphs: The table below is the core argument of this page. It costs a 4BI1 intervention at five different starting points, from the beginning of Year 10 to six weeks before the paper, in hours of tuition rather than in dirhams, so that any of the published rate bands can be applied to it. The pattern is consistent across every cohort we see: the total hours needed rise as the start date slips, the hourly rate rises with it because late work is specialist work in peak season, and the amount of change achievable falls.

The reason is the breadth of the specification rather than its difficulty. Five sections of recall-led and reasoning-led content cannot be compressed the way a single arithmetic skill can. A student starting in September of Year 10 is building the recall surface alongside the school, at one hour a week, with the extended-prose habit forming while there is still time for it to form. A student starting in March of Year 11 is attempting to assemble the same surface in a quarter of the time, in the term when school assessments are heaviest.

What the right-hand column records is the honest limit. No tutor can promise a particular grade at any starting point, and a six-week start is genuinely useful for recall-led sections and genuinely unable to change how a student writes a six-mark answer. Families who are told otherwise are being sold something that does not exist. The useful conversation in March is about which sections to abandon and which to secure, and a provider who will have that conversation is worth more than one who promises everything.

sections.heading: The hidden line item: who pays for marking a long answer
paragraphs: Biology carries more extended prose than physics or chemistry. Four and six-mark answers on digestion, gas exchange, homeostasis and the nitrogen cycle are where most of the available marks sit, and the only way a student improves at them is to have them marked by somebody who knows what the scheme awards. That takes time outside the lesson. A tutor marking a full 4BI1 long-answer section properly spends a substantial part of an hour on it, and that hour is either inside the rate, billed on top, or not being spent.

No published rate card in this market states which. That silence matters more in biology than in any other science, because in biology the marking is the service. A student who writes a six-mark answer, has it returned with a tick and a comment saying good detail, has learned nothing; a student who has it returned with the scheme's four required points identified and two of them missing from their answer has learned the whole skill. The second takes a person forty minutes and the first takes ten seconds.

So the question to put to any provider is narrow and answerable. How many long answers will be marked between sessions, by whom, and is that time inside the figure you have quoted. A provider who includes it will say so. A provider who bills it will say so. A provider who does neither is quoting for the taught hour only, which is a legitimate model at a lower price and a poor fit for this particular subject. sections.heading: The five sections of 4BI1 and the cost of covering each
paragraphs: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology is examined through Paper 1B, two hours for 110 marks, and Paper 2B, one hour fifteen minutes for 70 marks: 180 marks in total, with Paper 1B at 61.1% of the subject total and Paper 2B at 38.9%. The entry is untiered and reported on the 9 to 1 scale, and there is no coursework and no separate practical examination. The specification also flags content examined only in Paper 2B, which is worth checking on the live specification at qualifications.pearson.com for your child's series.

For costing purposes the useful split is not between papers but between recall-led and reasoning-led material. Recall-led sections can be covered in a pair or a small group, tested rather than taught, and in some cases handed to the student with a testing schedule and no tutoring at all. Reasoning-led material needs individual marking and cannot be shared, because the work is redrafting one student's sentences. Sorting the five sections on that axis is how a family gets the breadth covered without paying one-to-one rates for all of it.

Section 5, use of biological resources, deserves a specific note because it is the most consistently neglected part of the qualification. It is taught at the end of most Dubai schemes of work, it is recall-led, and it carries real marks. A holiday block that covers crop plants, micro-organisms in food production, fish farming, selective breeding and genetic modification is a few hours of cheap work that most candidates never do, and it is the clearest example in this subject of coverage bought at the right time rather than at the right rate.

sections.heading: Dubai rate bands, read for a biology purchase specifically
paragraphs: The bands below are published figures from named providers, read in October 2026, with an added column that matters only in this subject: whether the band plausibly includes marking extended prose. No IB Gram row appears, because a quote follows a free consultation rather than a price list, and inventing a competitive-looking figure would be exactly the behaviour that makes this market so hard for a parent to read.

The honest finding is that the cheapest band has a real and specific use in biology that it does not have in physics or chemistry. A large part of this specification is recall, and recall can be tested by someone who does not know the specification deeply, provided somebody who does has set the schedule. A budget online tutor at the advertised AED 33 to 65 an hour, used to test Sections 1, 3 and 5 against a list prepared by a specialist, is a sensible purchase. The same tutor marking six-mark answers is not.

At the top end, the caution is the same as in every subject here. Rates of AED 500 to 650 and above are often attached to an examiner claim, and examiner status should never be used to imply access to marking, boundaries or paper content, nor accepted without evidence. The free test that works at any price point: ask the tutor to mark one six-mark biology answer your child has already written and explain, point by point, which of the scheme's required statements are missing. Anyone who knows 4BI1 can do that in ten minutes.
